integrity: Two separate acyclic Morse matchings, exhaustive isomorphism coverage, exact integral elementary pivots, and independently enumerated raw simplicial face/boundary data. The complete standard-library verifier and output are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification only for fully bidirected simple graphs through five underlying vertices; the full homotopy type is not determined; independent external audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp five-vertex threshold for torsion in bidirected multipath complexes
